selectionOrder: discard regimes with insufficient false-pass > 0.05 or sufficient retention < 0.90
maximize sufficient retention among feasible regimes
frozenCalibration.regimes: all distinct prediction regimes from probabilities with >= admission; candidate thresholds 0, each probability, 1
frozenCalibration.thresholdWithinSelectedRegime: midpoint of highest rejected and lowest admitted probability; empty boundaries 0/1; assert identical prediction signature
frozenCalibration.perFamilyMetrics: diagnostic only; no per-family threshold tuning
frozenCalibration.infeasibleBehavior: freeze failed report, no component lock, no relabel, resplit, hard-row deletion, gate relaxation or same-version repair
